firstPlayerRule: Everyone draws one tile. The player with the letter closest to A goes first, and a blank tile beats any letter.
clarifications: All drawn tiles go back in the bag, then everyone takes seven tiles in playing order.
internalEvidence: Downloaded the Hasbro US instructions for Scrabble Classic (2–4 players, 100 letter tiles, drawstring bag) from the Hasbro instructions site page scrabble-board-game-classic-word-game-for-kids-ages-8-and-up-fun-family-game-for-2-4-players-the-classic-crossword-game and extracted the text with pdftotext. PDF page 1, numbered setup step 4: everyone draws one tile, the letter closest to A goes first, a blank beats any letter, play moves clockwise; step 5 returns the tiles and deals seven each in playing order.
